extra.comment:notifications: Remote push is disabled on the free tier: the expo-notifications CONFIG PLUGIN was removed from plugins[] because it injects the 'aps-environment' entitlement, which a free Apple Personal Team cannot sign (and forces the Push Notifications capability to reappear on every prebuild). The expo-notifications PACKAGE stays installed, so LOCAL notifications still work. To enable remote push after Apple Developer Program enrolment: add "expo-notifications" back into plugins[], set tier to 'paid', prebuild, and add the Push Notifications capability in Xcode signing.
extra.comment: The mobile app points at ONE Workshop backend origin (see native/config.ts). No host is committed here: it defaults to the operator's public deployment, and you override for dev via EXPO_PUBLIC_WORKSHOP_URL in mobile/.env.local (e.g. a tailnet URL) or by adding "serverUrl": "https://..." to this block. /api is proxied to the backend at every origin, so one URL serves the WebView + native producers. tier flips to 'paid' after Apple Developer Program enrolment.
